# porch_group_member (Resource)

Adds a tenant member (user) to a group. The user must already be a member of the tenant (`porch_tenant_member`). Import with `<tenant>/<group_id>/<user_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "porch_group_member" "ada_parent" {
  tenant   = porch_tenant.smiths.id
  group_id = porch_group.parents.id
  user_id  = porch_tenant_member.ada.user_id # the user must be a member of the tenant
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) ID (or slug) of the group. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `tenant` (String) ID or slug of the tenant that owns this object. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `user_id` (String) ID of the user. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<tenant>/<group_id>/<user_id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import porch_group_member.ada_parent <tenant>/<group_id>/<user_id>
```
